papers.title: Thermodynamically Consistent Machine Learning for Fracture Prediction in Heterogeneous Materials
papers.summary: Understanding fracture behavior is critical for assessing the structural integrity and longevity. Highly time-consuming physics-based fracture simulations motivate the development of machine-learning-based fracture evolution prediction with surrogate models. However, most existing machine-learning models for fracture prediction operate as black boxes and require large training datasets to generalize reliably. In this work, Thermodynamically Consistent Latent Dynamics Identification (tLaSDI) for parametric systems is introduced to predict fracture patterns and evolution in heterogeneous materials. The model learns the thermodynamic state variable in a lower-dimensional latent space using parametric GENERIC Formalism-Informed Neural Networks (pGFINNs) that enforce key thermodynamic principles, such as total energy conservation and entropy generation. This model embeds physics into the neural network architecture using a hard-constraint method that inherently complies with the underlying thermodynamic principles. The proposed tLaSDI-pGFINNs is further enhanced by a Geometry-Conditioned Autoencoder in learning the geometry configuration for effective geometry-guided learning. The energy and entropy evolution histories demonstrate that the model preserves the thermodynamic constraints on unseen testing samples. The results further show that tLaSDI-pGFINNs can more accurately capture both fracture patterns and the subsequent fracture evolution than the purely data-driven Autoencoder Long Short-Term Memory (AE-LSTM) model.
papers.title_ja: 異種材料における破損予測のための熱力学整合性機械学習
papers.summary_ja: 本研究では、熱力学原理をニューラルネットワークのアーキテクチャにハード制約として組み込むことで、異種材料の破損挙動を予測するモデル「tLaSDI-pGFINNs」を提案する。パラメトリックGENERIC形式論に基づき、エネルギー保存則やエントロピー生成といった物理法則を厳密に満たす潜在空間での学習を実現した。さらに、幾何学条件付きオートエンコーダを用いることで、形状変化を効果的に学習し、従来のデータ駆動型モデル（AE-LSTM）よりも高精度に破損パターンとその進化を予測できることを示した。
papers.relevance_reason: 物理情報ニューラルネットとサロゲートモデルの高度な組み合わせであり、関心領域に直結する。

papers.title: L2G-SR: Learning to Guide LLM-based Symbolic Regression
papers.summary: Symbolic regression searches for an equation that explains observed data. Numerical error is commonly used to guide the search, but it alone can favor an accurate surrogate over a candidate with the right structure. We propose L2G-SR, a framework for LLM-based symbolic regression that guides search with a learned structural verifier. We construct structural supervision signal using tree edit distance (TED), accounting for commutative operators and alternative expression forms. A verifier first aligns numerical observations with the formulas, then learns to score a candidate's structural similarity to the target formula. At search time, the target formula is hidden and the verifier complements numerical error in parent selection. An analyst then uses verifier feedback and diagnostic tools to propose revisions, which a generator converts into refined expressions. On LLM-SRBench, L2G-SR achieves state-of-the-art numerical fit, equation level accuracy and TED across the evaluated LLM backbones and domains. L2G-SR demonstrates the value of learned structural guidance for LLM-based symbolic regression.
papers.title_ja: L2G-SR: LLMベースのシンボリック回帰を学習で導く
papers.summary_ja: 数値誤差のみでは構造が正しい候補を見逃す問題を解決するため、LLMを用いたシンボリック回帰フレームワークL2G-SRを提案する。木編集距離（TED）を用いた構造検証器を学習し、数値誤差と併せて探索を導くことで、目標式との構造類似性を評価する。検証器のフィードバックと診断ツールを活用して式を修正し、LLM-SRBenchにおいて数値適合度・式レベル精度・TEDのすべてで最先端性能を達成した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM活用とサロゲートモデル構築の両方に直結する手法

papers.title: Learning and Forecasting Multiscale Spatiotemporal Epidemic Dynamics with Lagrangian-Eulerian Graph Neural ODEs
papers.summary: Accurate medium- to long-range epidemic forecasting requires extrapolating high-dimensional, heterogeneous and nonstationary dynamics from partial observations. Yet hybrid models often leave implicit which observations inform which epidemic processes and how learned graph interactions modify system state. We introduce LE-EpiGNODE, which replaces generic message passing with process-specific, mechanism-guided neural operators: age-contact information drives Lagrangian infection generation, whereas mobility drives conservative Eulerian population transport within a structure-preserving universal differential equation. We evaluated LE-EpiGNODE across 14 controlled synthetic mechanisms spanning time-modulated, state-dependent, nonlinear and coupled dynamics, three complementary COVID-19 settings, 21 comparator models and five targeted ablations. Forecasting gains tended to become more pronounced at longer horizons; at the longest horizon, LE-EpiGNODE achieved the lowest WMAPE in all three real-world datasets, reducing error by 17.7-40.0% relative to the best baseline. Controlled ablations linked these gains to the Lagrangian-Eulerian decomposition and process-aligned priors, while synthetic ground truth showed that learned operators and induced state fluxes track known generating dynamics. These results support mechanism-organized graph neural dynamics as a route to reliable long-horizon extrapolation with directly testable, process-level mechanistic interpretation beyond trajectory accuracy.
papers.title_ja: ラグランジュ・オイラー型グラフニューラルODEによる多スケール時空間疫学動態の学習と予測
papers.summary_ja: 本研究は、疫学予測における長期的外挿の精度向上を目的に、メカニズム主導のニューラルオペレータを用いたモデル「LE-EpiGNODE」を提案する。年齢・接触情報による感染生成（ラグランジュ）と移動による人口輸送（オイラー）を分離し、構造保存型微分方程式として定式化することで、従来の汎用メッセージパッシングの解釈性不足を解消した。14種の合成データと3つのCOVID-19実データセットでの評価により、特に長期予測において既存ベースライン比で最大40%の誤差低減を達成した。アブレーション実験により、この性能向上がラグランジュ・オイラー分解とプロセス整合的な事前知識に起因することが示された。
papers.relevance_reason: ニューラルオペレータと物理情報モデリングの応用であり、手法の汎用性が高い

papers.title: When Is Muon Optimal? Radial Fragility and Minimax Geometry
papers.summary: Muon replaces a matrix gradient by an approximate polar factor and has shown strong empirical performance in neural-network training. The Isotropic Curvature Model (ICM) provides a curvature-based explanation for this update by asking when gradient orthogonalization minimizes a one-step local-loss surrogate. We investigate the stability of this explanation when the fixed input radius of the ICM is replaced by a general radial law. We introduce the Random-Radius Isotropic Curvature Model (RR-ICM) and the Polar-Factor Admissibility Set, which encodes exact scaled-polar optimality as a geometric condition on the positive polar factor of the gradient. We derive an exact characterization of this set for arbitrary radial laws and show that all nonscalar admissible responses arise from radial atoms aligned with curvature kinks. Consequently, every atomless radial law exhibits zero-capacity rigidity: exact scaled-polar optimality is possible only when the gradient is already a scaled column isometry. To connect the curvature-based framework with the established spectral geometry of Muon, we introduce the Minimax RR-ICM by replacing directional averaging with worst-case optimization over probability laws on the sphere. We prove that every nonzero global minimizer lies on the polar ray of the gradient, while its scale is determined by a one-dimensional convex problem. The corresponding admissibility geometry is a positive-semidefinite trace slab, in sharp contrast to the spherical-zonoid geometry of the RR-ICM. Together, these results expose the radial fragility of average-curvature explanations and provide a new minimax variational characterization of Muon's polar direction.
papers.title_ja: Muon が最適であるのはいつか？半径方向の脆性とミニマックス幾何学
papers.summary_ja: ニューラルネットワーク学習で高性能を示すオプティマイザ Muon の理論的根拠を、曲率ベースのモデル（ICM）の拡張を通じて再検討する。固定半径を一般化し、勾配の極分解における最適性の幾何学的条件を厳密に特徴付け、平均曲率の説明が半径方向の分布に対して脆弱であることを示す。さらに、最悪ケースを最適化するミニマックス枠組みを導入し、Muon の極方向が勾配の極射線上にあることを証明した。これにより、従来の平均ベースの説明の限界と、新しい変分法的な最適性の特徴付けが明らかになった。
papers.relevance_reason: 深層学習のオプティマイザ理論であり、ML手法全般の関心に合致

papers.title: Pairwise AUC Optimization Needs Corrective Power: A Unified View
papers.summary: Direct pairwise AUC-surrogate training is attractive because it trains toward the ranking metric used at test time, especially under class imbalance. This creates a direct alignment between the training objective and the evaluation metric, but such metric alignment alone does not guarantee that stochastic training remains corrective. We study this gap through Corrective Power: whether pairwise mini-batch updates produce stronger and more reliable improvements for more severe positive-negative ranking errors. Our main observation is that direct pairwise training can enter regions where severe errors remain common but no longer produce useful corrective motion. In such regions, even the mini-batch noise that would normally help SGD move along the steepest severe-error correction direction can become much weaker. In this paper, we seek a theoretical explanation for this by exploring the degenerate property of the U-statistics formed from the pairwise gradients therein. Our results provide a mechanistic explanation for several empirical patterns: (a) squared-hinge loss is often an effective AUC surrogate; (b) cross-entropy warm-up can help models that enter the AUC phase from a poor starting region; and (c) parameter-efficient fine-tuning from a pretrained model can reduce that need by starting closer to a favorable ranking geometry. Experiments on 8 CV tasks and 8 NLP tasks, using ResNet50, DenseNet121, DistilBERT-base, and Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct, support these predictions.
papers.title_ja: ペアワイズAUC最適化には修正力が不可欠：統一された視点
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、AUCを直接最適化するペアワイズ学習において、深刻なランキング誤差に対する「修正力」が失われる現象を理論的に分析する。U統計の退化特性を通じて、ミニバッチ更新が有効な修正方向に作用しなくなるメカニズムを解明し、スクエアドヒンジ損失やクロスエントロピーウォームアップの効果を説明する。ResNetやQwen2.5などのモデルを用いた実験により、事前学習からのパラメータ効率ファインチューニングが有利なランキング幾何学から開始できるため、ウォームアップの必要性を低減することを示した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMのファインチューニング手法と評価指標の最適化に直結する理論的知見を含むため。

papers.title: De-Risking Robotic Welding for In-Space Metal Joining Through Physics-Grounded Digital Twins
papers.summary: Growing interest in in-space servicing, manufacturing, and assembly has renewed attention on reliable metal joining for modular construction and on-orbit repair. Robotic welding is promising, but reduced-gravity and low-pressure operation remains poorly characterised and flight-like tests are limited. The UK Space Agency-supported ISPARK project is developing a physics-grounded digital twin for structured process de-risking. This paper evaluates a model-based prototype combining a finite-volume thermal weld-pool model, Gaussian-process (GP) and neural-network surrogates, and a simulated six-axis manipulator. The reduced model includes solid-liquid phase change, effective thermocapillary transport, and a local-pressure parameter. Gravity is assessed separately through a hydrostatic-to-capillary pressure ratio and does not enter the thermal energy equation. Across repeated five-fold cross-validation, the GP has lower normalised mean absolute error than the neural network for all eight outputs. In 10 held-out boundary cases, 74 of 80 solver responses fall within nominal 90% GP predictive intervals. A three-output GP query takes 249 microseconds, including scaling and predictive variance. In a simulated UR5 L-shaped-seam study, a proportional controller adjusts the synergic power-source setting as travel speed falls near the corner. Finite-volume re-evaluation finds all 12 closed-loop operating points and 9 of 12 open-loop points within an illustrative 1.0-3.0 mm root-side-width band. These simulation results support using the framework to screen welding conditions and control strategies before experimental tests. Thermal-vacuum, targeted reduced-gravity, and robotic hardware-in-the-loop studies are needed to assess the model and controller.
papers.title_ja: 物理ベースのデジタルツインによる宇宙空間金属接合におけるロボット溶接のリスク低減
papers.summary_ja: 宇宙空間でのロボット溶接プロセスを評価するため、有限体積法による熱モデルとガウス過程（GP）・ニューラルネットワークのサロゲートモデルを組み合わせたデジタルツインを構築した。検証の結果、GPはニューラルネットワークより低い誤差を示し、予測区間内に収まる信頼性が高いことが確認された。さらに、シミュレーション環境下でUR5マニピュレータを用いたフィードバック制御により、溶接条件のスクリーニングと制御戦略の事前評価が可能であることを示した。
papers.relevance_reason: 宇宙環境での物理プロセスに対し、GPやNNによるサロゲートモデルと制御を適用した高度な研究

papers.title: Beyond Fixed Acquisition Functions: Temporal Difference Active Learning for Perturbation Discovery
papers.summary: Genetic and drug perturbation screens are important tools for elucidating disease mechanisms and validating therapeutic targets, but experimental costs limit the number of candidates that can be tested. Existing perturbation screening methods typically update the surrogate model with feedback while keeping the acquisition function fixed, limiting their ability to adapt selection to different response landscapes. Experimental feedback reveals current hits and informs subsequent selection by updating candidate predictions, providing a training signal for learning how to select experiments. We formulate budgeted perturbation discovery as a sequential decision problem and propose Temporal Difference Active Learning (TDAL), which learns an acquisition function online through temporal difference learning from a single screening trajectory, accounting for current hits and future discoveries. TDAL uses the Hellinger distance between hit probabilities for unmeasured candidates before and after an experiment to weight successor value, and reuses measured outcomes through leave-batch-out (LBO) to construct virtual transitions and alleviate training data scarcity. Across eight public screens spanning single, double, and triple perturbations under varied experimental configurations, TDAL achieves an average rank of 1.63 among eleven methods and ranks first on four tasks, demonstrating its adaptability across response landscapes.
papers.title_ja: 固定された獲得関数を超えて：摂動発見のための時間差アクティブ学習
papers.summary_ja: 遺伝子や薬剤のスクリーニングにおいて、実験コストを考慮した候補選択の最適化手法を提案する。従来の固定された獲得関数に代わり、時間差学習を用いてオンラインで獲得関数を学習するTDAL（Temporal Difference Active Learning）を提唱する。単一のスクリーニング軌道から得られるフィードバックを活用し、現在のヒットと将来の発見を考慮した意思決定を行う。8つの公開スクリーンデータセットで検証し、11手法中平均1.63位という高い性能を示した。
papers.relevance_reason: 強化学習とサロゲートモデルを組み合わせた効率的な探索手法であり、ユーザーの関心と高度に一致する。

papers.title: Machine-learning-based neutrino-event generation constrained by experimental measurements
papers.summary: We present a generative surrogate for charged-current \(\nu_\mu\)-nucleus scattering that can be calibrated to measured differential cross sections without event-level experimental samples. Starting from a theoretical interaction model, we fine-tune the surrogate to a MicroBooNE measurement and show that this also improves the description of observables not used in the fit. The calibrated model can also be applied to measurements from different neutrino fluxes without retuning, while retaining event-level predictions of outgoing-muon kinematics. Our results show that experimental cross sections can directly constrain generative event models while preserving their applicability across different observables and beam configurations.
papers.title_ja: 実験測定値で制約された機械学習ベースのニュートリノ事象生成
papers.summary_ja: 荷電カレントのニュートリノ-核散乱に対する生成型サロゲートモデルを提案する。イベントレベルのデータなしで、微分断面積の実験測定値（MicroBooNE）を用いてモデルを較正し、フィッティングに使わなかった観測量の記述精度も向上させることを示した。較正済みモデルは、再調整なしで異なるニュートリノフラックスの測定にも適用可能であり、出射ミューオンの運動学予測を維持しつつ、実験断面積が生成モデルを直接制約できることを実証した。
papers.relevance_reason: サロゲートモデルと物理データによる制約・較正という手法が関心に合致

papers.title: Physics-informed Kolmogorov-Arnold networks (PIKANs) for noise-robust reconstruction of boiling heat flux from infrared measurements
papers.summary: Recovering a noise-amplified inverse quantity from corrupted boundary data is a recurring problem in physics-informed learning for real-world applications. Specifically, small perturbations in the measured field are magnified through the spatial derivatives needed to reconstruct the target, and hence conventional discretization solvers turn them into large unphysical oscillations. We study this problem through the reconstruction of local time-resolved nucleate-boiling heat flux, which cannot be measured directly and must be inferred from infrared surface temperatures by solving an unsteady three-dimensional heat-conduction problem with sharp and rapidly evolving liquid-vapor interface gradients. We show that neither network architecture nor optimizer alone overcomes the spectral bias that smooths away these interface-scale features, and that the two must be addressed jointly. Our approach combines a Chebyshev physics-informed Kolmogorov-Arnold network (PIKAN) backbone, a quasi-second-order (SOAP) optimizer, and a temperature-annealed residual-based resampling scheme that concentrates collocation points at high-residual interface regions. Trained directly on experimental infrared measurements imposed as a boundary condition, the network resolves high-frequency bubble signatures and the high-flux distribution tail much better than a Fourier-feature PINN of equal size and training budget. In particular, it selectively filters measurement noise while preserving the physically meaningful high-frequency features, suppressing the spurious oscillations that contaminate finite-volume reconstructions and yielding more physically consistent heat-flux estimates from noisy experimental data.
papers.title_ja: 赤外測定からの沸騰熱流束のノイズ耐性再構築のための物理情報Kolmogorov-Arnoldネットワーク（PIKANs）
papers.summary_ja: 本研究は、赤外温度測定から沸騰熱流束を逆問題として再構築する際に生じるノイズ増幅と非物理的振動を抑制する手法を提案する。Chebyshevベースの物理情報Kolmogorov-Arnoldネットワーク（PIKAN）と、高残差領域に配置点を集中させる温度アニーリング付きサンプリング、およびSOAPオプティマイザを組み合わせることで、スペクトルバイアスによる高周波数特徴の平滑化を防ぐ。実験データを用いた検証により、同等規模のFourier-feature PINNや有限体積法よりも、バブルシグナルや高熱流束分布の尾部をより正確に再現し、ノイズをフィルタリングしつつ物理的に一貫した推定値を得られることを示した。
papers.relevance_reason: 物理情報ニューラルネットと新しいアーキテクチャ（KAN）の組み合わせが関心に直結

papers.title: Co-designing a Layered Control Architecture
papers.summary: Layered control architectures (LCAs) are ubiquitous in complex engineering systems. However, in practice they are largely designed ad hoc and mostly dictated by the experience of the designer. This is because there is currently no systematic and practically applicable theory available to holistically design LCAs. Hence, systematically reasoning about the optimality, stability, and feasibility of the LCA design is not possible. We set a first step toward such a theory by presenting a framework for co-designing a two-layer LCA for a linear time-invariant plant. The resulting co-design problem optimizes over architectural design variables (e.g., reduced order model dimension and sampling ratio between the layers) and tuning-based design variables (e.g., the numerical values of the feedback gain or the matrices of the reduced order model), all subject to constraints that ensure stability, feasibility, and compute properties of the closed-loop LCA. The proposed formulation allows to make informed tradeoffs along the Pareto front traced over different axes of optimality, e.g., speed, accuracy or computational effort. We demonstrate the effect of making various tradeoffs in a simple numerical example.
papers.title_ja: 階層型制御アーキテクチャの共同設計
papers.summary_ja: 複雑な工学システムで広く使われる階層型制御アーキテクチャ（LCA）の設計が経験則に依存している問題に対し、線形時不変プラントを対象とした体系的な共同設計フレームワークを提案する。本手法は、縮約モデルの次元や層間のサンプリング比といったアーキテクチャ変数と、フィードバックゲインなどのチューニング変数を同時に最適化し、安定性・実現可能性・計算特性の制約下でトレードオフを管理する。これにより、速度・精度・計算負荷の各軸におけるパレートフロン上の最適解を体系的に導出可能となり、設計の合理性を定量的に評価できる。数値例を通じて、異なる設計変数間のトレードオフがシステム性能に与える影響を実証している。
papers.relevance_reason: 縮約モデルと制御設計の統合最適化は、ユーザーの関心であるサロゲートモデルと軌道設計の高速化に直結する手法だから。

papers.title: Causal Fingerprints Reveal Hidden Mechanisms in Partially-Observed Dynamical Systems
papers.summary: In partially-observed dynamical systems, distinct hidden mechanisms can produce similar observable summary statistics while explaining individual events differently. We introduce causal fingerprints: realization-dependent patterns that track how information about a hidden state is revealed through subsequent evolution. Within a prescribed dynamical model, we compare the filtering posterior, based on observations up to a given time, with the smoothing posterior, obtained after adding an expanding window of future observations. We quantify this retrospective information gain using Kullback-Leibler divergence and track its evolution as the future window of observational data expands. The fingerprint reveals both the strength and temporal reach of hidden influence, which can vary across events and their stages. Because the observed trajectory is held fixed while hidden-state inference depends on the candidate model, fingerprints reveal how competing dynamical mechanisms explain the same observations even when selected statistics agree. In linear Gaussian systems, we derive a characteristic fingerprint timescale for the temporal reach of hidden influence. Calibrated surrogates matching the observable mean, variance, and decorrelation time can still produce distinct fingerprints when feedback memory, hidden-noise memory, or hidden forcing timescales are misrepresented. Nonlinear examples reveal mechanism-dependent signatures for extreme bursts, oscillatory variability, and regime switching, including multiplicative instability versus additive forcing, deterministic nonlinear feedback versus state-dependent multiplicative noise, and intrinsic bistability versus hidden double-well forcing. Causal fingerprints therefore provide a time- and event-resolved diagnostic for asking not only whether a model reproduces observed statistics, but how its hidden dynamics explain individual events.
papers.title_ja: 因果指紋が部分的に観測された動的システムの隠れたメカニズムを明らかにする
papers.summary_ja: 部分的に観測された動的システムにおいて、観測統計量が類似しても隠れたメカニズムが異なる場合がある問題に対し、因果指紋という概念を提案した。フィルタリング事後分布とスムージング事後分布のKLダイバージェンスを用い、未来の観測データによる情報利得の時間的進化を追跡することで、隠れた状態の影響の強さと時間的範囲を定量化する。線形ガウス系では特徴的な指紋時間スケールを導出し、非線形系では極端なバーストや振動変動、レジームスイッチングにおけるメカニズム依存のシグネチャを特定した。これにより、モデルが観測統計を再現するだけでなく、個々のイベントをどのように説明しているかを時間・イベント分解して診断できる手法を提供する。
papers.relevance_reason: サロゲートモデルの検証・物理情報推論に直結する手法

papers.title: Feature Elicitation for SAE Steering of Deceptive Behaviour in Small LLMs
papers.summary: Research on deceptive alignment is becoming increasingly urgent as frontier-model capabilities advance and their risk of causing catastrophic harm increases. Alignment faking is a form of deceptive alignment, with the compliance gap serving as a key behavioural indicator. This behaviour remains understudied in small LLMs and prior mechanistic interventions have not been shown to mitigate the compliance gap. We test whether steering SAE (sparse autoencoders) features associated with deontological ethics can mitigate this behaviour. We use a novel bag-of-words feature elicitation pipeline for SAE steering to identify what we construe as concept-level steering directions. Our approach reduced the compliance gap to non-significance in Gemma-3-27B-IT, whereas the tested configurations were not effective in LLaMA-3-8B-Instruct. Analysis of scratchpad traces also revealed deceptive model behaviour which we term deceptive defanging: deliberately degrading the aligned functionality of a response (in this case harmfulness) while preserving the appearance of alignment (in this case helpful compliance with the harmful request), sometimes conditioned on tier, training, or RLHF consequences. These findings provide, to our knowledge, the first evidence that a mechanistic activation-level intervention can mitigate the compliance gap in an alignment faking setup. They also identify a form of deceptive behaviour that may broaden our understanding of the different forms of deceptive behaviour in LLMs.
papers.title_ja: 小型LLMにおける欺瞞的行動のSAEステアリングのための特徴抽出
papers.summary_ja: 小型LLMにおける「アライメント偽装（欺瞞的整列）」を緩和するため、スパースオートエンコーダ（SAE）の特徴量を用いた介入手法を提案する。新しい単語袋ベースの特徴抽出パイプラインにより、道徳的倫理に関連する概念レベルのステアリング方向を特定し、Gemma-3-27B-ITにおいてコンプライアンスギャップを有意に縮小した。また、モデルが意図的に有害性を低下させつつ一見整列しているように見せる「欺瞞的無害化」という新たな欺瞞的行動パターンを発見した。本研究は、メカニスティックな活性化レベルの介入が欺瞞的行動を緩和できる初の証拠を提供する。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMの内部解釈と行動制御、ハルシネーションや安全性対策に直結する手法

papers.title: Same Answer, New Box: How Much of RLVR's Out-of-Domain Gain Is Answer Format?
papers.summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is credited with gains beyond the domain its rewards check, such as higher MMLU accuracy after training on mathematics. Such accuracies are usually read out of the model's text by an answer extractor. A model that learns to write its answer where the extractor looks can therefore score higher without answering better. We measure how much of the gain reported by extractors copied from public code arises this way. We generate outputs from a base model and its RL model and score them twice: with those extractors, and with one extractor of our own that reads a stated answer whether it is in the answer box \boxed{} or in the text. On four released 7B SimpleRL base-RL pairs, 82% of the out-of-domain multiple-choice gain that these extractors report disappears under ours: it is a gain in answer format, not in answers. The base models already state most of their answers in text, and RL moves them into the box, where these extractors look first. Independent LLM readers, in place of our extractor, put the figure at 77%. With a prompt that itself asks for the box, our extractor puts it at 79%. On a 32B pair trained with another recipe, almost none of the reported gain is format gain: its base model boxes its answers when asked, and its RL model rarely does when not. A reported gain is partly a property of the extractor that read it, and re-scoring stored outputs with a second extractor shows how much, without re-running RL.
papers.title_ja: 同じ答え、新しい枠：RLVRのドメイン外での向上のどれほどが回答形式によるものか
papers.summary_ja: 検証可能な報酬を用いた強化学習（RLVR）によるLLMの性能向上が、実際の推論能力ではなく回答抽出器（エクストラクター）の仕様によるアーティファクトである可能性を調査した。公開コード由来の抽出器と、回答形式に依存しない独自の抽出器を用いて再評価した結果、7Bモデルでは報告されたドメイン外向上の82%が「回答を指定された枠内に書くようになったこと」による形式上の向上であることが判明した。この手法により、RLを再実行せずに既存の出力データから真の性能向上と形式偏りの割合を分離・評価できることを示した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM評価手法・ベンチマークの信頼性検証であり、実務応用に関わる重要知見

papers.title: Causal Analysis of Robot Foundation Models Enables Efficiency Gains
papers.summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models are a promising approach to general purpose robot manipulation. While the internal computation of vision-language models, which compose the backbone of VLAs, has been studied extensively, less is known about how their perceptual and semantic representations are transformed into action in VLA models. We study this question mechanistically in three frontier VLA models ($\pi_{0.5}$, MolmoAct2, and MolmoBot) by analyzing the causal pathways through which the input image and the instruction shape actions. Across the three models, activation patching shows that causally relevant information influences the action expert (AE) through a narrow band of mid-to-late cross-attention layers, which we term the action-conditioning interface. The content of this information changes with token and layer within the model. Early-to-mid layer representations of the target noun token determine which object is selected, whereas mid-to-late layers carry the spatial information in text tokens that redirects the movement when patched. Where spatial information is stored in prompt tokens various based on the architecture. In MolmoAct2 the model forms task-conditioned representations at the text positions that follow the instruction, whereas $\pi_{0.5}$ additionally stores this information at image token positions. We show that these findings can be translated directly into improving model efficiency. We find that restricting MolmoBot's action expert conditioning to only 3 out of 36 layers reduces inference FLOPs by up to $33\%$ while maintaining comparable task success with the default model across 3,000 evaluation episodes ($46.7\%$ vs. $46.9\%$), and the same principle carries over to real-robot deployment of $\pi_{0.5}$.
papers.title_ja: ロボット基盤モデルの因果分析による効率化
papers.summary_ja: 視覚言語行動（VLA）モデルにおいて、入力画像や指示がどのように行動変換されるかを因果的に分析した。中間〜後期のクロスアテンション層が行動決定に重要である「アクション条件付けインターフェース」を特定した。この知見を活用し、条件付け層を3層に制限することで、推論FLOPsを最大33%削減しつつタスク成功率を維持できることを実証した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM基盤モデルの推論高速化と効率化に直結する手法

papers.title: Optimal Hydra: Model Heterogeneous Federated Learning for LLMs using Data-Informed Hydra-Nets
papers.summary: Large language models (LLMs) trained on vast amounts of data have demonstrated impressive performance over a range of tasks, but future performance gains will require increasing amounts of data and compute. Federated Learning (FL) facilitates training on decentralized private data, but client resource limitations can make training impractical, particularly as model sizes continue to expand. These resource constraints make the assumption of a shared server-client architecture impractical. Model heterogeneous FL offers a promising alternative by adapting model size to client capabilities; however, previous work is limited to the pre-training setting, and conclusions on sub-network selection do not necessarily hold for fine-tuning. Furthermore, prior approaches create client sub-networks without considering their unique data distributions, thereby overlooking the opportunity to tailor sub-network architecture to local data. Motivated by evidence that attention heads exhibit task dependency within layer defined feature spaces, we propose Optimal Hydra, a transformer based heterogeneous FL framework for fine-tuning that combines global layer selection with client specific attention head selection, aligned with local data distributions. Optimal Hydra makes explicit use of client data to produce client-specific sub-networks we call Hydra-nets. To our knowledge, this is the first model heterogeneous FL approach tailored to LLM fine-tuning. Experiments on three datasets show significant improvements over baseline methods while also reducing local resource demands.
papers.title_ja: Optimal Hydra: データ情報に基づく Hydra-Nets を用いた LLM 向けモデル非同期連合学習
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、LLM のファインチューニングにおけるリソース制約を解決するため、モデル非同期連合学習（Model Heterogeneous FL）フレームワーク「Optimal Hydra」を提案する。従来の手法が事前学習に限定されていたのに対し、本手法はクライアント固有のデータ分布に基づき、アテンションヘッドの選択を最適化することで、各クライアントに最適なサブネットワーク（Hydra-nets）を構築する。これにより、グローバルなレイヤー選択とローカルなヘッド選択を組み合わせ、リソース効率を向上させつつ、ベースライン手法と比較して性能の大幅な改善を実現した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM の効率化・推論高速化・RAG とエージェント設計への関連性が高い

papers.title: Verdict: Encode Once, Decide Many
papers.summary: Automating organizational work means answering many small typed questions about one piece of state (does this email need a reply, how urgent is it, who owns it) with probabilities good enough to act on without a human. The open typed-decision model we compare against, like a standard cross-encoder, answers each question with a separate pass over the input. We present Verdict-MQ, an open encoder that reads a case once and answers all of its questions: given identical retained state tokens after truncation (verified on every reported case), a structured attention mask makes the state encoding independent of the questions, keeps questions from influencing each other, and makes option order irrelevant by construction. On the typed-decisions benchmark, a 395M Verdict-MQ matches the soft gold labels significantly better than the released 421M Laya specialist on all five fresh seeds (KL 0.080 vs 0.117, Brier 0.045 vs 0.061), an advantage that survives per-system temperature scaling; its higher accuracy (0.801 vs 0.767) lies past the benchmark's own saturation point, so we read that margin as closer agreement with the benchmark's labelling teacher. On RACE, BoolQ and MultiRC, against a matched fine-tuned baseline it wins on MultiRC and loses on RACE and on BoolQ, where its training is unstable; we measure zero-shot references ourselves, including a closed general system (Jev) that beats every fine-tuned encoder. A controlled comparison measures what the shared state costs: giving each question its own question-aware copy of the state gains 0.9-3.5 points on RACE and MultiRC at 1.4-2.5x the per-case latency, and nothing measurable on typed decisions, with the invariance guarantees unchanged.
papers.title_ja: Verdict: 一度エンコードし、多数の判断を行う
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、単一の入力状態に対して複数の型付き質問（分類タスク）を一度のエンコードで回答するオープンソースモデル「Verdict-MQ」を提案する。構造化アテンションマスクにより、状態エンコーディングが質問内容や選択肢の順序から独立することを保証し、推論効率を向上させる。ベンチマーク評価では、同規模の既存モデルより高い精度と安定性を示し、特に型付き判断タスクで優位性を発揮した。また、質問ごとに状態を複製する手法との比較を通じて、共有状態のコストと利得を定量的に分析している。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM推論高速化・効率化とエージェント設計に直結する手法

papers.title: Gibbs-Gap Policy Optimization for Off-Policy RL with Verifiable Rewards
papers.summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards often trains language models on responses generated by a different, possibly stale behavior policy. Correcting this mismatch with learner-to-behavior importance weights can introduce high variance for long responses. We introduce Gibbs-Gap Policy Optimization (GGPO), which minimizes a log-mean-exp contrast of KL-adjusted rewards among responses to the same prompt, without learner-to-behavior importance weights. We derive GGPO from KL-regularized policy optimization: on policy, its population loss is exactly the KL-regularized optimality gap, and under suitable coverage the learner's single-response expected reward is at least the behavior policy's best-of-$K$ reward, minus terms for the raw finite-group loss, regularization, and finite training data. We characterize reference refresh through exact Gibbs-target composition and a finite-data final-policy reward bound under local reference control and tokenwise behavior mismatch. This refresh is empirically important: in an ablation, fixed-reference GGPO scores $32.96$ on the five-benchmark problem-weighted average, versus $46.58$ with the default refresh schedule. Experiments on mathematical reasoning further show that GGPO outperforms GRPO and AGRO under training-inference mismatch and on fixed offline data, while maintaining its performance as controlled policy staleness grows.
papers.title_ja: 検証可能な報酬を用いたオフポリシー強化学習のためのギブス・ギャップ・ポリシー・オプティマイゼーション
papers.summary_ja: 検証可能な報酬を用いたLLMの強化学習において、学習ポリシーと行動ポリシーの不一致（オフポリシー問題）による高分散を解決するGGPO手法を提案する。KL調整済み報酬の対数平均指数対比を最小化することで、重要性重み付けなしに安定した学習を実現する。理論的にはKL正則化最適性ギャップと関連付けられ、参照ポリシーの更新が性能に与える影響を定量的に分析した。数学推論タスクにおいて、既存手法（GRPO, AGRO）を上回る性能を示し、ポリシーの陳腐化に対する頑健性を実証した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMの強化学習効率化と推論性能向上に直結する手法

papers.title: Amortizing Sequential Experimental Design in Reasoning LLMs
papers.summary: Despite their extensive pretraining knowledge and strong reasoning capabilities, large language models (LLMs) struggle to adaptively gather information in experimental design tasks. We study how to amortize sequential Bayesian experimental design (BED) into an LLM by explicitly training the reasoning that guides action selection using information-gain rewards. Our approach specifies the experimental generative model independently of the LLM's own beliefs, allowing us to optimize expected information gain under a model of our choosing. We investigate the design choices for amortization, including alternative generative-model constructions, reward estimation, hypothesis-space specification, multi-step objectives, and computational costs relative to training- and inference-time BED baselines. On Twenty Questions, the resulting policies improve information acquisition and task performance, outperform inference- and training-time BED baselines at substantially lower computational cost, and generalize to unseen categories. We further demonstrate positive transfer from Twenty Questions training to Medi-Q, a real-world clinical dialogue benchmark. These results suggest that information gathering can be learned as a generalizable reasoning skill in LLMs.
papers.title_ja: 推論LLMにおける逐次実験設計のアモルタイズ
papers.summary_ja: 大規模言語モデル（LLM）が逐次ベイズ実験設計（BED）において適応的に情報を収集する能力に欠如している問題を解決するため、情報利得報酬を用いて推論を明示的に訓練する手法を提案する。LLM自身の信念とは独立に実験生成モデルを指定し、期待情報利得を最適化することで、推論時・訓練時のBEDベースラインよりも計算コストを大幅に削減しつつ性能を向上させる。Twenty Questionsタスクで高い情報収集効率と汎化性能を示し、さらに臨床対話ベンチマークであるMedi-Qへの正の転移も実証した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM推論強化とベイズ最適化の融合であり、ユーザーの関心領域に直結する。

papers.title: pcNN-SN: a physics-enhanced predictor-corrector neural network algorithm coupled with the discrete ordinates method for neutron transport equations
papers.summary: Super-resolution machine learning methods hold promise for addressing the high computational costs associated with high-dimensional features in traditional transport simulations. This paper proposes a physics-enhanced neural network coupling algorithm for discrete ordinates (SN) transport calculations. Based on high- and low-accuracy data, we develop a predictor-corrector neural network (pcNN) to predict correction factors for coarse-grid solutions. Based on transport equations, local physical features containing subgrid-scale information are selected as network inputs. Dimensionless transformation of physical quantities reduces the input space dimensionality and narrows parameter distributions, facilitating network training. Physical constraints are incorporated into the network model, and the corrected solution retains its original conservation properties. pcNN and SN transport sweeps are internally coupled, and numerical solutions are corrected online. Numerical results demonstrate that this algorithm can effectively improve coarse-grid solutions to achieve a level of accuracy comparable to that of fine-grid results. The physics-based network design enables the model to demonstrate a certain degree of reusability under different computational conditions. Compared to mesh refinement, the pcNN-SN algorithm reduces the computation time for the three-dimensional test problem by more than 60%.
papers.title_ja: pcNN-SN: 中性子輸送方程式に対する離散方向法と結合した物理強化型予測・補正ニューラルネットワークアルゴリズム
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、離散方向法（SN）による中性子輸送計算の計算コスト削減を目的に、物理強化型予測・補正ニューラルネットワーク（pcNN）を提案する。輸送方程式に基づく局所物理特徴量を入力とし、粗メッシュ解の補正係数を予測することで、細メッシュ計算に匹敵する精度を達成する。物理制約をネットワークに組み込むことで保存性を維持し、3次元問題においてメッシュ細分化と比較して計算時間を60%以上短縮した。
papers.relevance_reason: 物理情報ニューラルネットとサロゲートモデルによるシミュレーション高速化の典型例

papers.title: FlowBudget: Training-Free Sampling-Budget Estimation for Flow Matching Models
papers.summary: Sampling from continuous flow-based generators such as flow matching models requires numerical ODE or SDE integration, making inference cost depend on the number of function evaluations (NFEs). In practice, the sampling budget is inherited from prior work or selected through expensive FID-versus-NFE sweeps, using FID to assess image-generation quality, requiring sample generation and evaluation at multiple budgets. This makes sampling-budget selection dependent on repeated empirical evaluation. We therefore ask a complementary question to solver design and timestep allocation: for a fixed pretrained model and solver, what numerical resolution is sufficient? We introduce FLOWBUDGET, a training-free estimator of solver-relative sampling complexity. Using simulation-free interpolation probes of the learned dynamics, FLOWBUDGET normalizes the leading one-step discretization error by the motion, estimates its coefficient from interpolation probes, and maps a numerical tolerance to a step budget using the solver order. We derive estimators for numerical solvers in flow~matching sampling, namely Euler and Heun for ODE sampling and additive-noise Euler--Maruyama for SDE sampling, and connect the ODE coefficients to terminal integration error. Experiments on SiT, FlowDCN and Rectified Flow models, spanning flow-model architectures and formulations, test whether FLOWBUDGET can estimate the NFE budget without generating samples at multiple budgets or performing an FID-versus-NFE sweep. The code is available at https://github.com/Yasaman-dt/FlowBudget
papers.title_ja: FlowBudget: フローマッチングモデルにおける学習不要なサンプリング予算推定
papers.summary_ja: フローマッチングモデルの推論コストを決定する数値積分のステップ数（NFE）を、サンプル生成やFID評価なしに推定する手法を提案する。学習済みダイナミクスに対する補間プローブを用い、1ステップ離散化誤差を運動量で正規化することで、ソルバーの精度とステップ予算を対応づける。Euler法やHeun法など主要なODE/SDEソルバーに対して推定器を導出し、既存モデルでの有効性を検証した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM推論高速化と類似の計算効率化手法であり、実務応用性が高い

papers.title: Latent Annealed Posterior Sampling with a Variance-Preserving Bridge for Sparsely Observed Random Fields
papers.summary: Posterior inference for random fields from sparse observations presents two major challenges: accurately characterizing complex spatial uncertainty and preventing conditional sampling costs from growing substantially as the spatial grid is refined. To address these challenges, we propose latent annealed posterior sampling (LAPS). LAPS first maps the random field into a latent space with reduced dimensionality, while a coordinate decoder composed of Branch and Trunk networks enables field evaluation at arbitrary spatial locations. Flow matching is then used to learn the latent prior distribution. Based on this learned prior, posterior sampling is performed entirely in the latent space, with the observation likelihood incorporated progressively through an annealing procedure. To control local covariance inflation, we introduce a variance-preserving (VP) bridge that allocates a covariance budget between the transported latent state and a Gaussian perturbation. Numerical experiments demonstrate that LAPS accurately approximates posterior distributions, preserves distinct posterior modes, and reduces the dependence of conditional sampling costs on spatial resolution. Across two Gaussian benchmarks, LAPS attains small errors against exact posterior references, with sliced Wasserstein distances only 2 to 3 percent higher than the reference values obtained from exact posterior samples. In a bimodal posterior problem, LAPS reduces the sliced Wasserstein distance from 0.2693 to 0.1499 and consistently recovers both modes across all test scenarios. For a two dimensional Navier-Stokes random field, LAPS substantially improves marginal posterior calibration, while its evaluation time remains nearly constant as the output grid is refined from 64^2 to 512^2. These results demonstrate that LAPS achieves a favorable tradeoff among posterior accuracy, uncertainty calibration, and computational efficiency.
papers.title_ja: スパース観測されたランダム場のための、分散保存ブリッジを用いた潜在アニーリング後方サンプリング
papers.summary_ja: スパースな観測データからランダム場の後方分布を推定する手法LAPSを提案する。低次元な潜在空間へマッピングし、フローマッチングで事前分布を学習することで、空間解像度の向上に伴うサンプリングコストの増大を抑制する。分散保存ブリッジを導入し、局所共分散の膨張を制御しながら、アニーリングにより観測尤度を段階的に組み込む。数値実験により、後方分布の精度と不確実性キャリブレーションを維持しつつ、計算効率を大幅に向上させることを示した。
papers.relevance_reason: 物理情報モデルとサロゲートによる推論高速化の両立

papers.title: Evaluating Model Capabilities After Benchmark Saturation
papers.summary: Rapid advances in AI capabilities are causing benchmarks to saturate. Once several models approach perfect scores, a benchmark loses its power to differentiate between them, and with it its utility for informing AI safety cases and frontier policies. Yet benchmark items produce far more information than the scores we typically extract from them: a full transcript of how each model solved the task. We investigate whether these transcripts can be used to assess model capabilities even after benchmark scores have saturated. We simulate saturation retrospectively using historical benchmark and model releases, and test whether protocols that access only correctly solved transcripts from saturated benchmarks can predict capabilities measured on held-out, unsaturated items. We evaluate representative contemporary approaches for extracting information from model transcripts: pairwise judging, single-transcript absolute scoring, and predictions from deterministic transcript features or embeddings. We find that saturated transcripts retain capability information beyond benchmark accuracy. Amongst our evaluated protocols, pairwise judging performs best, reducing prediction error by 5.3 times compared to a baseline using only saturated benchmark scores. This capability-relevant information is distributed across transcript sections, but concentrated in specific channels of information such as reasoning and tool-calls. However, the predictive power of protocols does not always generalise across distribution shifts -- for example by underestimating the capabilities of the first reasoning models introduced in early 2025. Saturated benchmarks thus retain capability-predicting signal in their task transcripts, but extending the lifetime of existing benchmarks requires methods designed to extract these signals robustly.
papers.title_ja: ベンチマーク飽和後のモデル能力評価
papers.summary_ja: AIモデルのベンチマークスコアが飽和し差別化が困難になる問題に対し、タスク解決のトランスクリプト（詳細ログ）から能力を推定する手法を提案する。過去データを用いたシミュレーションにより、飽和したベンチマークでも正解トランスクリプトから未飽和タスクの能力を予測可能であることを示した。評価プロトコルの中ではペアワイズジャッジングが最も高性能で、ベースライン比で予測誤差を5.3倍低減した。ただし、推論モデルなど分布シフトに対しては汎化性能が低下する点も指摘されている。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM評価・ベンチマーク設計とハルシネーション対策に直結する手法

papers.title: AlphaDiana: A Measurement System for Agents in Verifiable Reasoning Tasks
papers.summary: Agents pair reasoning models with harnesses that organize model calls, execute tools, load skill instructions, and retain history in memory. Understanding agent performance requires linking execution conditions to outcomes, behavior, and resource use. We introduce AlphaDiana, a measurement system with modular interfaces for datasets, agents, environments, and scorers. It preserves harness-native control loops while controlling file reuse and memory retention separately. AlphaDiana supports macro analyses of complete agents and micro interventions on agent components such as tools, skills, and memory under matched conditions. We study three open-source models and three open-source harnesses on five answer-based benchmarks, with two models also tested on two interactive benchmarks. We find that harnesses do not consistently improve the accuracy of reasoning: gains on questions unsolved by the model alone can be outweighed by losses on questions it answers correctly without tools. This inconsistency extends to component interventions: neither skill guidance nor retained history reliably improves accuracy. Behavior and output-token use must be assessed with correctness: low token entropy can accompany wrong answers, and less output per execution can mean more output tokens per correct answer when accuracy falls. AlphaDiana links answer correctness and execution status to traces and resource records for comparing agents and diagnosing failures under shared task and resource policies.
papers.title_ja: AlphaDiana: 検証可能な推論タスクにおけるエージェントの計測システム
papers.summary_ja: 検証可能な推論タスクにおけるAIエージェントの性能を正確に評価するための計測システム「AlphaDiana」を提案する。このシステムは、データセット、エージェント、環境、スコアラーのインターフェースをモジュール化し、ハーネス固有の制御ループを維持しつつ、ファイル再利用やメモリ保持を独立して制御できる。オープンソースモデルとハーネスを用いた実験では、ツールやスキル、履歴の保持が必ずしも精度向上に寄与しないこと、およびトークン使用量と正答率の相関が複雑であることを示した。本手法は、共有されたタスクとリソースポリシー下でのエージェント比較や失敗要因の診断を可能にする。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMエージェント設計と評価手法の両方に直結する重要な研究

papers.title: Causal Syntax Circuits in CodeLMs: Budget and Probe Decide What Looks Localised
papers.summary: Code models write Python when the prompt does not say which language to use. We ask a mechanistic question about that habit: is it produced by a small, findable group of components inside the model? We run one pipeline---mean ablation, activation patching, greedy circuit extraction, a random-control significance test, and activation steering---over 55 model-language settings spanning ten open code models (five base and five instruction-tuned), three target languages (Rust, C#, PHP), two prompt suites, and two component budgets. We report five findings. First, the preference is large, grows with model size, and survives instruction tuning: it is larger on every instruction-tuned checkpoint than on its base version, by 12% on average. Second, its measured size is mostly a property of the probe; replacing our aligned prompts with XLCoST parallel functions takes the same measurement on the same models from about 1.6 to about 0.01. Third, whether the preference looks localised depends on how many components the search may keep: with a budget of 12, 1 of 15 settings yields a circuit that beats size-matched random controls after multiple-comparison correction, and with a budget of 40, 6 of 15 do. Fourth, interventions that a smaller-budget study reports as uniformly failing do sometimes succeed: patching makes a Python prompt prefer target syntax in 2 of 45 settings, and steering changes the most likely next token in 9 of 45. Fifth, every circuit whose effect is significant but points away from the target language comes from a setting where circuit extraction failed, which makes such results a diagnostic rather than a phenomenon. The practical lesson is that a claim about whether a behaviour is localised can turn on analysis choices that papers rarely report. We release the full grid so those choices can be varied.
papers.title_ja: コードLLMにおける因果的構文回路：予算とプローブが局所性の見かけを決定する
papers.summary_ja: コード生成モデルがPythonを優先する傾向のメカニズムを、平均アブレーションやアクティベーションパッチングを用いて55のモデル設定で検証した。この傾向はモデルサイズや指示チューニングで強まるが、その「局所性」は評価手法（プローブ）や探索するコンポーネントの予算に大きく依存することが判明した。特に、予算が小さいと回路の検出率が低下し、介入実験の結果も変動するため、分析選択が結論を左右する。本研究は、行動の局所性に関する主張が分析手法に敏感であることを示し、再現可能な評価グリッドを公開している。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMの内部メカニズム解明と評価手法の重要性が関心に合致

papers.title: Ordinal-pattern transition networks as a symbolic substrate for reservoir computing
papers.summary: Reservoir computing has established itself as a computationally efficient alternative to fully trained recurrent neural networks using a fixed high-dimensional nonlinear substrate to map temporal input into a feature space for a simple readout. Here, we argue that reservoir computing can be realized entirely within a coarse-grained, symbolic state space, and that constrained random walks on ordinal-pattern transition networks provide a natural instance of this realization, replacing the reservoir's continuous state space with a discrete and directly data-derived one. We develop a formal correspondence between the two frameworks, show that the echo-state property has a natural discrete analog in the ergodicity and spectral gap of the walk's underlying Markov chain, and illustrate the correspondence with a minimal example and an empirical one-step-ahead prediction task evaluated across five paradigmatic model systems. These systems exhibit dynamics that correspond to strictly periodic, quasiperiodic, chaotic, or stochastic signals. We argue that this symbolic reservoir perspective allows a redefinition of the reservoir substrate itself, replacing the requirement of a continuous, randomly generated dynamical system with any sufficiently ergodic, data-derived symbolic process. This opens a route toward interpretable, data-adaptive reservoirs whose internal structure is inferred rather than randomly assigned, with implications for surrogate-data methods and reservoir design more broadly.
papers.title_ja: 順序パターン遷移ネットワークによるリザーバーコンピューティングの象徴的基盤
papers.summary_ja: 本研究は、連続的な状態空間を用いる従来のリザーバーコンピューティングを、離散的な順序パターン遷移ネットワーク（象徴的状態空間）上で実現する手法を提案する。ランダムウォークのエルゴード性とスペクトルギャップがエコー状態特性の離散アナログであることを示し、厳密周期・準周期・カオス・確率的シグナルを含む5つのモデル系で予測性能を検証した。このアプローチにより、ランダムに生成される連続ダイナミクス系を、データから推論される解釈可能な象徴的過程で置き換えることが可能となり、サロゲートデータ手法やリザーバー設計の新たな方向性を示唆している。
papers.relevance_reason: リザーバーコンピューティングとサロゲートモデル設計の関連性

papers.title: Optimally Trading Energy for Information through Speed Trajectory Optimization of Sustainably Powered Mobile Robots
papers.summary: Sustainably powered mobile robots enable long-duration observational missions by harvesting energy from the environment. However, effective autonomy requires the robots to make decisions as to how to allocate this energy to maximize information quality over time. In this paper, we study a persistent (infinite-horizon) speed trajectory optimization problem that is posed as a periodic optimal control problem in which a robot repeatedly traverses a fixed closed path, coupling a super-linear propulsion cost with dynamic information gain and decay. Using the information-theoretic quantity of clarity as an information metric, we first derive the necessary conditions for optimal control. We then derive a number of specialized follow-on properties, which characterize (i) the nature of the optimal control when points on the path are of varying importance and when they are of equal importance, along with (ii) a high-speed information limit that is approached when energy reserves approach infinity. We illustrate the information-optimal speed trajectories on a simple example in order to showcase key trends that are followed under the optimized speed profile. This is followed by a simulation study based on the persistent characterization of salinity in the Chesapeake Bay, illustrating the practical merit of applying the results from this work.
papers.title_ja: 持続可能給電モバイルロボットの速度軌道最適化によるエネルギーと情報の最適トレードオフ
papers.summary_ja: 環境からエネルギーを収穫する持続可能給電モバイルロボットにおいて、情報品質を最大化するための速度軌道最適化問題を定式化する。超線形推進コストと動的な情報獲得・減衰を結合した周期最適制御問題として扱い、情報理論的指標「クリアネス」を用いて最適制御の必要条件を導出する。パス上の各点の重要度に応じた最適制御の性質や、エネルギー無限大時の高速情報限界を理論的に特徴付け、チェサピーク湾の塩分持続監視シミュレーションで実用性を示す。
papers.relevance_reason: 軌道最適化と制御理論の手法は関連するが、対象が宇宙機ではなく地上/水中ロボットであり、ML活用も限定的。

papers.title: Regions of Attraction of CBF-Based Safety Filters for Stable Planar Linear Systems
papers.summary: In this paper we study the dynamical properties induced by safety filters based on control barrier functions (CBFs). These are obtained by minimally modifying a nominal controller with the goal of rendering it safe. We consider the simple setting of a planar linear plant with a stable linear nominal controller and an affine constraint. We show that even in this simple setting, the filtered system can oscillate or diverge while remaining safe. We fully characterize the parameters for which the origin is globally (exponentially or asymptotically) stable. For all other parameters, the filter creates a saddle on the constraint boundary, and we characterize the region of attraction of the origin. For underdamped nominal dynamics, its boundary is an unstable periodic orbit, a homoclinic loop, or the saddle's stable manifold, depending on whether the CBF gain is below, at, or above a homoclinic transition value. A vehicle sideslip example and two three-dimensional examples illustrate the results and what changes beyond planar dynamics.
papers.title_ja: 安定な平面線形系におけるCBFベースのセーフティフィルタの引き込み領域
papers.summary_ja: 制御バリア関数（CBF）を用いたセーフティフィルタが安定な平面線形系に与える動的性質を解析した。単純な設定であっても、フィルタ適用後に振動や発散が生じ得ることを示し、原点が全局的に安定であるためのパラメータ条件を完全に特徴づけた。不安定な場合、制約境界上にサドル点が生じ、その引き込み領域の境界が不安定周期軌道やホモクラインループとなることを明らかにした。車両のサイドスリップや3次元系の例を通じて、結果の妥当性と高次元への拡張性を示している。
papers.relevance_reason: 制御理論の基礎研究であり、MLや軌道力学との直接的な接点は少ない

papers.title: CQDC-Warp: GPU-Accelerated Differentiable Quasi-Dynamic Simulation for Contact-Rich Manipulation
papers.summary: Efficient synthesis of contact-rich manipulation trajectories is essential for downstream robot learning. Gradient-based planning offers a promising approach, but jointly optimizing motion and contact decisions remains challenging. Meanwhile, many existing planners run on CPUs with limited throughput. We present CQDC-Warp, a GPU-accelerated differentiable quasi-dynamic simulator for batched model predictive control (MPC). We use it to study contact-guided trajectory optimization, in which intended robot--object contacts are specified before planning and encouraged through soft costs, while the simulated dynamics determine contact geometry and frictional response without a prescribed contact-mode schedule. Across $17{,}408$ trials on the $17$-object Allegro in-hand rotation benchmark, our framework achieves $79.8\%$ success, compared with $73.7\%$ for CFree and $65.2\%$ for IMPACT, and reduces mean trajectory-generation time by factors of $27.0$ and $50.2$, respectively. On a single NVIDIA RTX 4090 with $2{,}048$ parallel worlds, forward and backward throughput reach $2.06\times10^5$ and $2.25\times10^5$ world-steps per second, respectively. Further experiments cover manipulation with LEAP and Shadow hands, environmental contact exploitation, bimanual manipulation, whole-body control, and real-world trajectory replay on a Sharpa hand.
papers.title_ja: CQDC-Warp: 接触が豊富な操作のためのGPU加速微分可能準動力学シミュレーション
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、GPU上で並列実行可能な微分可能準動力学シミュレータ「CQDC-Warp」を提案する。これにより、接触が複雑なロボットの操作軌道計画において、モデル予測制御（MPC）の計算速度を大幅に高速化した。Allegroハンドを用いたベンチマークでは、既存手法より高い成功率を達成しつつ、軌道生成時間を最大50倍短縮した。さらに、LEAPやShadowハンド、両手操作、全身制御など多様なシナリオでの有効性を検証している。
papers.relevance_reason: GPU加速と最適化は関心だが、対象がロボット操作であり軌道力学ではないため

papers.title: Value-Informed Schedule Trimming for Accelerated Sequential Monte Carlo Guidance in Discrete Diffusion
papers.summary: Reward-guided discrete diffusion enables test-time alignment with downstream objectives, but applying Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) guidance at every denoising step is computationally expensive. Active guidance steps require additional reward evaluations and, for gradient-based proposals, value-gradient computations. Sparse guidance reduces this cost by guiding only a subset of timesteps, but commonly used schedules are fixed heuristics whose effectiveness can vary substantially across tasks. We propose VISTA, a training-free method that automatically selects guided timesteps under a fixed budget. VISTA formulates sparse guidance as approximation of the ideal full-guidance probability path and derives an estimable upper bound on \(\ell_1\) path deviation. Using value statistics collected from a small number of full-guidance warmup generations, VISTA optimizes the resulting empirical surrogate exactly via dynamic programming. The warmup generations can be retained as model outputs, and after schedule selection VISTA has the same per-generation guidance complexity as other sparse schedules with the same budget. Across text, biological sequence, and image generation tasks, VISTA discovers task-dependent schedules and outperforms hand-designed sparse schedules in most tested settings, while approaching or exceeding full-guidance performance on several task metrics. In toxic-text generation, for example, VISTA attains a 0.99 unique-toxic ratio compared with 1.00 for full guidance while reducing post-selection per-generation latency from 204.23 s to 38.16 s, a 5.35$\times$ speedup.
papers.title_ja: 離散拡散における加速された逐次モンテカルロガイダンスのための価値情報に基づくスケジュールトリミング
papers.summary_ja: 離散拡散モデルにおける逐次モンテカルロ（SMC）ガイダンスの計算コストを削減する手法VISTAを提案する。固定予算下で、完全ガイダンスの確率パスを近似する最適なタイムステップ選択を動的計画法により解く。少数のウォームアップ生成から得られる価値統計を用い、訓練不要でタスク依存のスパーススケジュールを自動決定する。テキストや画像生成において、手動設計のスケジュールを上回る性能と最大5.35倍の高速化を実現した。
papers.relevance_reason: 拡散モデルの推論高速化と動的計画法による最適化が関心に該当

papers.title: GRID-Planner: Graph-Structured Relational Reward Shaping for Diffusion Planning
papers.summary: Autonomous driving planning requires selecting trajectories that remain safe, rule-compliant, and comfortable under complex multi-agent interactions, yet robust closed-loop decision making in planning-critical scenes remains challenging. Existing diffusion- and RL-based planners often rely on generic rewards and use relational structure mainly for representation, limiting how planning-critical rollouts shape policy improvement. We present GRID-Planner, a graph--reward integrated diffusion planning framework that aligns generative planning with structured relational signals. Specifically, GRID-Planner combines graph-aware importance weighting, a time-indexed relational reward surrogate, and an advantage-weighted diffusion objective with on-policy self-distillation, forming a rollout-return-advantage-update loop without explicit likelihoods. Experiments on nuPlan and interPlan show that, compared with the diffusion-only baseline, GRID-Planner reduces collision rate, lane deviation, and jerk by 35.8\%, 60.8\%, and 27.4\%, respectively, and improves the planning score by 3.4\%. Project website: https://github.com/yangzhaojason/GRID-Planner.
papers.title_ja: GRID-Planner: 拡散モデル計画におけるグラフ構造関係報酬整形
papers.summary_ja: 自律走行の計画において、グラフ構造を用いた関係性シグナルと拡散モデルを統合するフレームワークを提案する。グラフ認識重要度重み付け、時間インデックス付き関係報酬サロゲート、アドバンテージ重み付き拡散目的関数を組み合わせ、明示的な尤度なしでポリシー改善ループを形成する。nuPlanおよびinterPlanでの実験により、衝突率・車線逸脱・ジャークを大幅に低減し、計画スコアを向上させることを示した。
papers.relevance_reason: 強化学習とサロゲートモデルの応用だが、対象が自律走行であり軌道力学とは異なるため中程度。

papers.title: DeepUnfolding_Agent: A Classical_Quantum Adaptive Control API
papers.summary: Adaptive optimization workflows in machine learning, federated learning, quantum machine learning, and hybrid classical quantum systems often embed controller logic directly inside task specific training scripts. This coupling limits reuse, reproducibility, safety validation, and fair comparison across execution environments. This paper presents DeepUnfolding Agent, a schema-driven FastAPI platform that exposes deep unfolded adaptive control as an external software service. External executors register a strategy schema, submit round-level diagnostic variables, receive schema-bounded control actions, execute one optimization round, and return feedback for controller update. The framework separates controller intelligence from domain specific execution through a strategy registry, diagnostic to state adapter, controller factory, safety guard, executor abstraction, feedback update path, SQLite persistence layer, Docker deployment, and reproducible benchmark scripts. The implementation supports classical, quantum-aware, hybrid, Qiskit Aer, and optional IBM quantum processing execution pathways. We validate the software through unit, schema, API, safety, orchestration, Quantum execution, checkpointing, and Docker tests, and demonstrate external user fixed versus adaptive workflows across finance, healthcare, genomics, transport, noisy quantum simulation, and hardware backed IBM Quantum execution. The results show that DeepUnfolding-Agent provides a reusable and traceable adaptive control layer for heterogeneous optimization workflows. Our quantum experiments are interpreted as API level quantum control and hardware portability evidence.
papers.title_ja: DeepUnfolding_Agent: 古典・量子適応制御API
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、機械学習や量子機械学習における適応最適化ワークフローのコントローラロジックを、タスク固有のスクリプトから分離し、再利用可能な外部ソフトウェアサービスとして提供するFastAPIベースのプラットフォーム「DeepUnfolding Agent」を提案する。戦略スキーマの登録、診断変数の送信、制御アクションの受信、フィードバックによる更新といったプロセスを標準化し、古典、量子、ハイブリッド環境での実行を可能にする。金融、医療、量子シミュレーションなどの多様な領域で、固定ワークフローと適応ワークフローの比較検証を行い、再利用性と追跡可能性の高い適応制御レイヤーであることを示した。
papers.relevance_reason: 適応制御と量子計算のAPI設計は関連するが、軌道力学やLLM推論の直接適用は限定的

papers.title: Exploring the Design Space of Permutation Diffusion LLMs
papers.summary: Permutation generation with language models requires both text-conditioned ranking and a global one-to-one assignment between candidates and output positions. We study this problem through three diffusion-LLM parameterizations: hard-assignment prediction over shuffled candidate-index sequences, soft-assignment prediction over doubly stochastic matrices, and direct ordering-score prediction followed by sorting. The three families place permutation constraints at different stages of prediction and decoding and therefore support different training objectives and sampling procedures. We evaluate these designs on recommendation reranking across three Amazon domains with candidate sets of size 10 and 20. At one function evaluation, the hard- and soft-assignment variants achieve Recall@1 comparable to a constrained masked-diffusion baseline, whereas direct ordering-score prediction guarantees valid permutations without Hungarian assignment or Sinkhorn normalization. Additional function evaluations do not consistently improve ranking quality, and their effect depends strongly on the state representation and training objective. These results show that corruption, prediction parameterization, objective, and decoder should be designed jointly for permutation diffusion with language-model denoisers.
papers.title_ja: 置換拡散LLMの設計空間の探求
papers.summary_ja: 言語モデルを用いた置換生成（ランキング）において、ハード割り当て、ソフト割り当て、直接順序スコア予測の3つのパラメータ化手法を比較検討した。Amazonデータセットを用いたリランキング評価では、直接順序スコア予測がハンガリアン法やシンクホーン正規化なしで有効な置換を保証しつつ、他の手法と同等のRecall@1を達成した。追加の関数評価はランキング品質の向上に必ずしも寄与せず、状態表現や学習目的との整合性が重要であることが示された。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMの応用だが、対象がリランキング特化で軌道力学や効率化とは無関係

papers.title: Diminishing Returns of Data in Sparse Autoencoders: Functional Behavior does not Guarantee Feature Reproducibility
papers.summary: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) are typically trained on hundreds of millions to billions of activation tokens, yet little work has tested whether this scale is necessary. We study how much activation data SAEs need by training four SAE architectures on three language models with budgets ranging from 5M tokens to a 500M-token reference. We measure two notions of convergence: functional behavior on standard evaluations and one-to-one reproducibility of learned features. Functional data requirements are strongly metric-dependent: reconstruction often approaches the full-data reference at substantially smaller budgets, whereas feature reproducibility continues to improve with data. For Gemma-2-2B BatchTopK, the fraction of strictly matched features rises from 2\% at 5M tokens to 29\% at 50M. Data selection also matters: random sampling better preserves the original activation distribution and generally favors reconstruction, whereas diversity-based sampling frequently improves AutoInterp. A theoretical analysis separates statistical consistency of subsampled training from the stronger identifiability and optimization conditions required for one-to-one feature recovery. Our results show that SAE training can often be made far more data-efficient when budgets are matched to the goal, and feature-level claims are backed by explicit reproducibility checks, paving the way toward cheaper and more reliable SAE research.
papers.title_ja: スパースオートエンコーダにおけるデータの逓減効果：機能行動は特徴の再現性を保証しない
papers.summary_ja: スパースオートエンコーダ（SAE）の学習に必要なデータ量と、その収束特性を評価した研究である。再構成精度などの機能面では少量データで十分だが、学習された特徴の一対一の再現性はデータ量増加に伴い向上し続けることを示した。また、ランダムサンプリングと多様性ベースサンプリングが再構成と解釈可能性に与える影響の違いを分析し、目的に応じたデータ予算設定の重要性を理論的・実証的に論じた。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM内部表現解析の効率化に関わるが、軌道力学や推論高速化とは直接無関係

papers.title: Interpreting Language Model Parameters
papers.summary: Mechanistic interpretability aims to uncover how neural networks use their parameters to implement their impressive neural algorithms. Although previous work has uncovered substantial structure in the intermediate representations that networks use, little progress has been made to understand how the parameters and nonlinearities of networks perform computations on those representations. In this work, we present a method that brings us closer to this understanding by decomposing a language model's parameters into subcomponents that each implement only a small part of the model's learned algorithm, while simultaneously requiring only a small fraction of those subcomponents to account for the network's behavior on any input. The method, adVersarial Parameter Decomposition (VPD), optimizes for decompositions of neural network parameters into simple subcomponents that preserve the network's input-output behavior even when many subcomponents are ablated, including under ablations that are adversarially selected to destroy behavior. This encourages learning subcomponents that provide short, mechanistically faithful descriptions of the network's behavior that should aggregate appropriately into more global descriptions of the network's learned algorithm. We study how sequences of interactions between these parameter subcomponents produce the network's output on particular inputs, enabling a new kind of 'circuit' analysis. While more work remains to be done to deepen our understanding of how neural networks use their parameters to compute their behavior, our work suggests an approach to identify a small set of simple, mechanistically faithful subcomponents on which further mechanistic analysis can be based.
papers.title_ja: 言語モデルのパラメータの解釈
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、機械的可解読性（Mechanistic Interpretability）の観点から、言語モデルのパラメータを単純なサブコンポーネントに分解する手法「adVersarial Parameter Decomposition (VPD)」を提案する。この手法は、敵対的に選択されたアブレーション（機能除去）下でもネットワークの入出力挙動を維持するよう最適化することで、モデルのアルゴリズムを構成する最小限の機能的要素を特定する。これにより、特定の入力に対する出力生成過程を「回路」分析として追跡可能となり、ニューラルネットワークがパラメータを用いて計算を実行するメカニズムの理解を深めることを目指す。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMの内部構造理解は重要だが、効率化や軌道力学との直接的な関連は薄い。

papers.title: Multi-Dimensional Featurizers Yield Fine-Grained Steering and Data Shaping in Robot Foundation Models
papers.summary: Can better feature discovery improve control over robot behavior through internal interventions and training data? Recent work in vision and language models reveals multidimensional features, motivating block-sparse featurizers (BSFs), which represent each feature in a low-dimensional subspace. We investigate whether recovering this structure provides an interpretable interface for steering vision-language-action models and shaping the data from which they learn. We show that BSFs recover several multi-dimensional task-relevant features underlying the model's computation (e.g., perception, language, proprioceptive state, episode phase, and control variables). We causally validate these features through fine-grained steering: targeted changes in visual perception, semantic representation, and spatial localization produce predictable changes in downstream action prediction. Finally, we use feature-based data attribution to isolate where a specific behavior (failure recovery) arises in the training dataset, identifying fewer than $1.4\%$ of training tokens whose masking is sufficient to remove the targeted behavior. Overall, our results show how matching featurizers to representation geometry can provide more effective tools for understanding and changing robot behavior.
papers.title_ja: 多次元フィーチャライザーによるロボット基盤モデルの細粒度ステアリングとデータ整形
papers.summary_ja: 視覚・言語・行動モデル（VLA）において、ブロックスパースフィーチャライザー（BSF）を用いて多次元のタスク関連特徴を復元し、解釈可能なインターフェースとして活用する手法を提案する。因果検証により、視覚知覚や言語表現などの特定特徴に対する介入が、下流の行動予測に予測可能な変化をもたらすことを示した。さらに、特徴ベースのデータ帰属分析により、失敗回復といった特定行動を学習データから除去するために必要なトークンが全体の1.4%未満であることを特定した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMの解釈可能性とデータ整形に関わるが、対象がロボット制御であり軌道力学とは無関係

papers.title: Complete or Sparse: A Tale of Two Identifiabilities
papers.summary: Understanding when neural networks learn interpretable representations is central to mechanistic interpretability. We study this through identifiability: when can supervised learning recover the true latent variables underlying the data? We introduce two data generating processes distinguished by their causal direction where either labels cause latents (generative) or latents cause labels (discriminative). When the representation has at least as many dimensions as the latent space, we prove that the optimal encoders are linear in the latents. Conversely, when dimensions are insufficient, identifiability generically fails and encoders become nonlinear. We then show that additional constraints yield recovery of individual latent variables, not just linear mixtures. In the generative setting, non-negative activations and energy efficiency force each neuron to encode exactly one latent, providing a precise account of selective grandmother cell-like responses. In the discriminative setting, when latents are sparse and the true measurement matrix satisfies the spark condition, the learned encoder inherits compressed sensing structure, enabling sparse dictionary learning to perfectly recover individual latents. This constitutes, to our knowledge, the first identifiability result for undercomplete nonlinear independent component analysis. Our framework unifies nonlinear ICA, compressed sensing, and neural network interpretability, delineating exactly when representations transition from nonlinear distortions to linear representations and, under additional constraints or steps, to clean, axis-aligned codes. Theoretical predictions are validated on synthetic benchmarks and on activations drawn from vision models, large language models, and macaque inferotemporal cortex.
papers.title_ja: 完全かスパースか：二つの識別可能性の物語

papers.title: Iterative Neural Variational Solver of Committor Function in Under-damped Langevin Dynamics
papers.summary: The committor function describes the probability that a stochastic dynamical system, while transitioning between two metastable states, will first reach one state rather than the other. It is a central object in transition path theory, providing the accurate reaction rate and the characterization of the transition mechanism through reactive probability flux and the transition state ensemble. While the numerical methods for this function are well studied for over-damped Langevin dynamics where the friction damping coefficient goes to infinity, its computation in the general under-damped case remains an open challenge due to the lack of a variational structure in the underlying backward Kolmogorov equation. This restricts the quantitative investigation of the impact of the finite damping coefficient on rare transitions in real systems. In this work, by decomposing the infinitesimal generator of the underdamped Langevin dynamics into a self-adjoint and a skew-adjoint part, we develop an iterative scheme in which each subproblem has a variational form and can be solved efficiently using neural networks. Fundamentally, this approach can be viewed as a generalized Concus-Golub-Widlund (CGW) splitting method and each subproblem has a variational form, which can be solved efficiently. This iterative scheme also has the flexibility of introducing a preconditioning operator associated with a new overdamped Langevin dynamics, which naturally leads to the design of enhanced adaptive sampling for the subproblems. We validate the efficiency and accuracy of our method on benchmark systems including a one-dimensional double-well potential, the Muller-Brown potential, and alanine dipeptide. The proposed iterative variational framework provides a practical and extensible numerical tool for probing rare transition events in Langevin dynamics across varying damping coefficients.

papers.title: KNOU-Flood: Advancing global streamflow forecasting with lead-aware probabilistic machine learning
papers.summary: Global streamflow forecasting supports flood preparedness, yet data-driven models trained on reanalysis lose skill when driven by operational forecasts, increasingly so with lead time. AIFL addresses this shift with a two-stage transfer-learning recipe and a deterministic LSTM, but it feeds one forecast lead time into the whole input window and gives no uncertainty. We ask how far this open recipe can be extended without changing its recurrent core. KNOU-Flood keeps a single-layer LSTM and the two-stage training and changes the information around it: a longer input window (424 days), lead-aware forecast inputs, GraphCast as a second forecast source next to ECMWF HRES, and a latent-noise ensemble trained with the fair CRPS. We compare against a re-implementation of the AIFL recipe (its code is not public) under identical data, stations, splits and metrics. Our contributions are threefold. First, over three seeds and 2,099 test basins (2021-2023), KNOU-Flood reaches a median KGE' of 0.65 at LT1 and 0.48 at LT10 against 0.62 and 0.34, with significant gains at all ten lead times under two scoring protocols, also against a 1024-unit baseline and on held-out basins (one seed each). Second, identical weights give an LT10 KGE' of 0.18 or 0.34 depending on how forecasts are fed, so much of the lead-time decay reported for AIFL is an input-protocol effect; the probabilistic head contributes most to the gain, followed by the raw GraphCast channels, the longer window and mixed fine-tuning. Third, the ensembles reach lower CRPS than probabilistic versions of the baseline, are nearly calibrated with inference-time dropout, and detect 1.5- and 2-year floods better than all baselines; the benefit for rarer floods depends on the seed, and an exploratory tail-weighted variant improves 10-year and larger events. KNOU-Flood is a controlled extension of an open recipe, not a new architecture.

papers.title: Graph Additive Models disentangling feature, topology, and interactions
papers.summary: Graph Neural Additive Networks (GNANs) have emerged as effective, interpretable-by-design architectures for graph learning. They achieve transparency by combining per-feature shape functions with simple distance-based reweighting. However, GNANs have three limitations. First, node-wise relevance scores aggregate information from all graph nodes, allowing irrelevant nodes to inherit spurious relevance from relevant ones. Second, topology is represented only through shortest-path distances, so structurally distinct graphs may share identical distance profiles. Third, feature and distance information are combined multiplicatively, entangling feature, distance, and interaction effects in a single rescalable term. We introduce AMIGA, which represents topology through a vocabulary of mined motifs and decomposes each node contribution into three additive channels: feature, structure, and feature-structure interaction. The channels are centered around a graph-balanced training baseline, making the decomposition well-defined and unique under the chosen reference distribution. Across ten graph classification and regression benchmarks, AMIGA outperforms GNAN on most datasets and narrows the gap with standard black-box GNNs. Because each channel is centered and assigned to a single node, AMIGA produces node-local explanations that reconstruct the model output exactly and support interpretation at multiple levels of granularity.

papers.title: On the Stability and Convergence of Flow Map Training
papers.summary: Flow maps are a recent method of probabilistic generation that amortize diffusion trajectories into one-step samplers, unlocking efficient generation. While progress has been made in improving their empirical performance, there is still a lack of understanding behind the mechanisms underlying their success. Specifically, many flow map learning methods employ stop gradient operators as a crucial part of their training target. Adaptive weighting also drastically improves the generation capabilities of flow maps. Although many interpretations have been proposed to support the inclusion of these heuristics, none have analyzed the impact of these assumptions on the training dynamics of flow maps themselves. In this work, we address this issue by providing grounded theory explaining why such tricks are required. Analyzing the functional gradient flow induced by the MeanFlow and Lagrangian losses, we show their convergence to the true flow map, settling the validity of these objectives. For finite updates, we highlight a severe roadblock to the usage of these losses in practice: the possible unboundedness of the update. Adaptive normalization not only provides bounded updates, but, combined with a specific weighting, additionally provides convergence guarantees towards a neighborhood of the solution. On synthetic data, we show that our functional gradient flow analysis exactly describes the true training dynamics for flow maps. Experiments on standard image datasets demonstrate that a proper reweighting scheme is essential for strong empirical performance, which is only achieved for a specific range of reweighting strengths.
